name: Block Patterns | Gutenberg Reusable Block Patterns Plugin
author: Jaswinder Kaur

sections.description:
Enhance your content creation workflow with the Block Patterns plugin. Effortlessly manage reusable blocks from a streamlined admin panel, insert them into posts or pages using shortcodes, or display them in widget areas. Perfect for content creators and developers looking to improve efficiency with the block editor.

Key Features

  • Shortcodes: Insert reusable blocks anywhere using [bp id="ID"].
  • Widgets: Add reusable blocks to sidebars or other widget areas.
  • Enhanced Management: An advanced admin interface for seamless pattern handling.
  • Block Editor Integration: Fully compatible with Gutenberg for quick editing and updates.
  • Shortcode Column: Displays associated shortcodes in the Block Patterns admin list.

FAQs

How do I use a shortcode?
Use [bp id="BLOCK_ID"] to embed a reusable block. Replace BLOCK_ID with the block’s ID.

How do I add a reusable block to a widget area?
Go to Appearance > Widgets, add the “Reusable Block” widget, and choose your block.

Can I create custom patterns?
Yes, convert any reusable block into a custom block pattern for flexible use.

Support

For questions, feature requests, or bug reports, visit the support forum.

Thank you for using Block Patterns!
sections.installation:
1. Download and upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin under Plugins.
  3. Access settings via Settings > Block Patterns.
  4. Start adding, managing, and using reusable blocks as patterns.
